    (SELECT SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) 
     FROM customers AS T1 
     INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019" 
     WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM' AND T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK' 
     GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) 
     ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC

     WHERE "XCL_006" = 'SVK' AND "XCL_007" = 'Premium') AS premium_gas_station_count

     FROM customers AS T1 
     INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_019" 
     WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM' AND T1."XCL_003" = 'CZK' 
     GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2."XCL_020", 1, 4) 
     ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_021") DESC

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH czech_lam_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_001 AS customer_id
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'LAM'
      AND c.XCL_003 = 'CZK'
),
yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) AS year,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k t
    INNER JOIN czech_lam_customers clc ON t.XCL_013 = clc.customer_id
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011)
),
top_year AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        total_consumption
    FROM yearly_consumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
slovakian_premium_stations AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS station_count
    FROM gasstations
    WHERE XCL_006 = 'SK'
      AND XCL_007 = 'Premium'
)
SELECT 
    ty.year AS highest_consumption_year,
    sps.station_count AS slovakian_premium_station_count
FROM top_year ty
CROSS JOIN slovakian_premium_stations sps
